name: Ira C. Bellows
role: Mandan man; plaintiff in a Morton County court case
bio: Ira C. Bellows of Mandan visited Medora in June 1884. In September 1885 he and James Bellows were listed as plaintiffs in a Morton County district court case.

moments.label: Named plaintiff in a Morton County court case

mentions: Ira C. Bellows, of Mandan, was in Medora a few days last week. He has large interests in Mandan and is with good cause a firm believer in her future.
